Our promise

Every customer gets clear information, fair pricing and a follow-up call after the job. We stock and supply only genuine products from established manufacturers, and we can advise on quantities, finishes and alternatives that suit your budget. Our staff are trained and experienced, and they will tell you honestly if something is not right for your project.

We offer delivery within Nairobi and to nearby towns, and we can arrange site visits for larger orders. Corporate and institutional customers can open an account with us for faster ordering and monthly statements. Contractors who work with us regularly get priority scheduling and dedicated support from our team.

Visit our showroom to see samples in person or ask for photos on WhatsApp. We update our stock every week and we are happy to reserve items for you while you make a decision. Thank you for supporting a local business.

Opening hours

Monday to Friday 8:00 to 18:00, Saturday 8:00 to 15:00. Closed on Sundays and public holidays.

Areas we serve

Our customers come from all over Nairobi and the neighbouring counties, including Westlands, Kilimani, Kileleshwa, Lavington, Karen, Lang'ata, South B, South C, Embakasi, Kasarani, Ruaka, Ruiru, Juja, Thika, Kitengela, Athi River, Syokimau and Rongai. If you are not sure whether we cover your area, send us a message and we will confirm the same day. We plan our schedule a week ahead, so it helps to let us know early about bigger jobs, but we always try to fit in urgent requests.

We keep things simple: a clear quotation, an agreed timeline, regular updates and a final walk-through with you before we close the job. Payment terms are explained upfront and receipts are issued for every transaction.
